description.value:
You've learned to summon a raging storm in a 30-foot radius centered on you. As an action, you gain the following for 1 minute: a flying speed matching your walking speed, resistance to energy, lightning, and necrotic damage, and any hostile creature entering the radius for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, takes 10 lightning damage.

The storm ends early if you're incapacitated or die. Once used, this feature is unavailable again until you finish a long rest.
